All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
BackgroundCommand
Holds a single "background task" slot: at most one Command runs through this object at a time, and assigning a new task automatically cancels whatever was previously running in that slot.
ControlConstants
Proportional Integral Derivative Feedforward, constants for combining PID and Feedforward
ControlConstants.ControlType
Which closed-loop control scheme a Controller should use, determining which onboard/software control mode setPosition/setVelocity dispatch to.
Controller
Abstract base for a Ninjas motor controller wrapper: a hardware-agnostic API for driving a single motor mechanism (with optional followers) in percent-output, position, or velocity control, and for reading back its encoder position/velocity, current draw, and limit switches.
Controller.ControllerLogs
A struct-serializable, loggable snapshot of a Controller's state at one instant - see Controller.getLogs().
Controller.ControllerLogs.ControllerLogsStruct
WPILib Struct (de)serializer for Controller.ControllerLogs, enabling it to be logged and replayed as raw bytes.
Controller.ControllerType
The physical (or simulated) motor controller hardware a Controller wraps, used to pick the right implementation in Controller.createController(ControllerType, ControllerConstants).
Controller.ControlState
The closed/open-loop mode a Controller is currently commanded in.
ControllerConstants
Top-level configuration for a Controller: bundles the real-hardware settings (ControllerConstants.real) used on the robot with the simulated mechanism (ControllerConstants.simSystem) used when running in simulation, so one constants object can build either kind of controller via Controller.createController.
DerivativeCalculator
Computes a smoothed time-derivative (rate of change) of a scalar value sampled over time, e.g.
DerivativeCalculator2d
Computes a smoothed time-derivative (velocity) of a Translation2d value sampled over time, e.g.
DetachedCommand
An InstantCommand that hands command off to the CommandScheduler as its own independently-scheduled command, instead of running it inline.
FieldLayoutGetter
Supplies the AprilTagFieldLayout used for vision pose estimation, with the ability to exclude specific tag IDs.
Gyro
Wraps a GyroIO implementation to give the rest of the robot code a single, hardware-agnostic gyro API: it caches the latest GyroIO.GyroIOInputs and exposes typed getters, and logs every field via NinjasLogger on each Gyro.periodic() call.
GyroIO
Hardware-agnostic interface for a swerve gyro, following the AdvantageKit-style IO pattern: implementations read the physical (or simulated) sensor and populate a plain GyroIO.GyroIOInputs data object each cycle, so higher-level code (see Gyro) never touches vendor APIs directly.
GyroIO.GyroIOInputs
Plain data holder for one cycle's worth of gyro readings, populated by GyroIO.update().
GyroIONavX
GyroIO implementation for a NavX (AHRS) IMU over SPI (MXP port).
GyroIOPigeon2
GyroIO implementation for a CTRE Pigeon 2 IMU over CAN.
GyroIOSim
Simulation implementation of GyroIO, backed by an ironmaple GyroSimulation instead of real hardware.
LimelightHelpers
LimelightHelpers provides static methods and classes for interfacing with Limelight vision cameras in FRC.
LimelightHelpers.IMUData
Encapsulates the state of an internal Limelight IMU.
LimelightHelpers.LimelightResults
Limelight Results object, parsed from a Limelight's JSON results output.
LimelightHelpers.LimelightTarget_Barcode

LimelightHelpers.LimelightTarget_Retro
Represents a Color/Retroreflective Target Result extracted from JSON Output
LimelightHelpers.PoseEstimate
Represents a 3D Pose Estimate.
LimelightHelpers.RawDetection
Represents a Limelight Raw Neural Detector result from Limelight's NetworkTables output.
LimelightHelpers.RawFiducial
Represents a Limelight Raw Fiducial result from Limelight's NetworkTables output.
LimelightVisionCameraIO
VisionCameraIO implementation for a real Limelight smart camera.
LoggedCommandController
Wraps a LoggedCommandControllerIO (PS5 or Xbox gamepad) to provide AdvantageKit logging of every button, POV, and axis on the controller, plus convenience accessors for binding commands.
LoggedCommandControllerIO
Hardware-agnostic IO interface for a game controller (PS5 or Xbox gamepad).
LoggedCommandControllerIO.LoggedCommandControllerIOInputs
A snapshot of every button, POV, and axis state read from a controller in a single LoggedCommandControllerIO.update() call.
LoggedCommandControllerIOPS5
LoggedCommandControllerIO implementation for a PlayStation 5 (DualSense) controller, backed by a PS5Controller.
LoggedCommandControllerIOXbox
LoggedCommandControllerIO implementation for an Xbox controller, backed by an XboxController.

LoopCommand
Wraps a command and runs it repeatedly, restarting it (calling end() then initialize() again) each time it finishes, for a fixed number of repeats.
NinjasAutoBuilder
Wrapper around PathPlanner's AutoBuilder that only exposes auto-building and auto-choosing functionality.
NinjasLogger
Thin wrapper around DogLog that adds sequentially-numbered event logging.
NinjasPoseTracker<T>
A generic, odometry-plus-vision pose tracker for a drivetrain of type T (the wheel/module position type, e.g.
NinjasSwervePoseTracker
A NinjasPoseTracker specialized for swerve drivetrains, backed by a SwerveDriveOdometry.
OdometryThread
A singleton background thread that samples odometry-relevant signals (CTRE Phoenix status signals and arbitrary DoubleSuppliers) at a fixed frequency, higher than the main robot loop, and hands out per-signal Queues of the sampled values plus a matching timestamp queue.
PhotonVisionCameraIO
VisionCameraIO implementation for a real, physically-connected PhotonVision camera.
PhotonVisionSimCameraIO
VisionCameraIO implementation for a simulated PhotonVision camera, used when Robot.isSimulation() is true.
RealControllerConstants
Real-hardware configuration for a Controller: motor IDs/inversion/current limits (RealControllerConstants.base), control-loop gains and gear ratio (RealControllerConstants.control), software position limits (RealControllerConstants.softLimits), limit-switch definitions (RealControllerConstants.hardLimits), and an optional CANcoder (RealControllerConstants.canCoder).
RealControllerConstants.Base
Motor IDs, inversion, brake/coast mode, current limits, followers, and CAN bus for a controller.
RealControllerConstants.Base.SimpleControllerConstants
The CAN ID and inversion setting for a single motor controller (main or follower).
RealControllerConstants.CANCoder
Configuration for an optional CTRE CANcoder providing absolute/remote position feedback.
RealControllerConstants.CANCoder.CANCoderMode
How a configured CANcoder's absolute position is combined with the motor controller's own encoder; see RealControllerConstants.CANCoder.mode.
RealControllerConstants.Control
Closed-loop control gains, gear ratio/conversion, and goal tolerances for a controller.
RealControllerConstants.HardLimits
Container for a controller's hard (and virtual) limit switch definitions.
RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.HardLimit
The configuration for one hard limit switch - either a real switch wired to a DigitalInput, or a "virtual" one inferred from motor stall current.
RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.LimitTriggerMethod
Callback invoked by Controller.periodic() when a RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.HardLimit newly becomes active.
RealControllerConstants.SoftLimits
Software-enforced minimum/maximum position limits for a controller, in mechanism units.
RobotPose
The robot's single source of truth for "where am I on the field".
SimulatedController
A Controller implementation for simulation: instead of talking to real motor hardware, it drives a WPILib LinearSystemSim (an ElevatorSim, SingleJointedArmSim, DCMotorSim, FlywheelSim, or a custom subclass, supplied via ControllerConstants.simSystem) and runs its own PIDController/ ProfiledPIDController/TrapezoidProfile in software to emulate the closed-loop behavior real motor controller firmware would otherwise provide.
SparkMaxController
Controller implementation that wraps a REV SparkMax brushless motor controller (via the REVLib SparkMax API).
StateEndCommand
Runs a sequence of commands one after another, like WPILib's SequentialCommandGroup, but with one key difference: once finished, StateEndCommand.isFinished() keeps returning true instead of the finished status being tied to the current command index.
StateMachineBase<StateEnum extends Enum<StateEnum>>
Generic base class for building a robot state machine as a SubsystemBase.
Swerve
Manages a 4-module swerve drivetrain: hardware/simulation setup, acceleration- and speed-limited driving via Swerve.drive(frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveSpeeds), odometry feeding, and module/gyro access.
SwerveConstants
Top-level, builder-style configuration for a swerve drivetrain: physical chassis dimensions, speed and acceleration limits, module/motor configuration, gyro selection, simulation-only parameters, and miscellaneous options, grouped into nested holder classes.
SwerveConstants.Chassis
Physical dimensions of the chassis and the kinematics derived from them.
SwerveConstants.Gyro
Which gyro hardware to build (via frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.gyro.Gyro) and how to configure it.
SwerveConstants.Gyro.GyroType
Supported gyro hardware types.
SwerveConstants.Modules
Configuration shared by all swerve modules: motor types/constants and per-module hardware IDs.
SwerveConstants.Simulation
Parameters used only by the physics simulation (motor models and module gearbox identity); ignored on a real robot.
SwerveConstants.Simulation.SwerveType
Supported swerve module gearbox families (WCP/SDS MK4 variants).
SwerveConstants.Special
Less commonly changed options: odometry threading, PathPlanner robot config, starting pose, CAN bus, and auto-lock.
SwerveConstants.Speeds
Physical speed/acceleration capabilities of the swerve and the soft limits enforced on them.
SwerveController
The recommended front door for driving the swerve: layers rotation-to-angle PID (SwerveController.lookAt(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Rotation2d)), point-to-point translation PID (SwerveController.pidTo(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d)), and a named-channel gate (SwerveController.setControl(frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveSpeeds, java.lang.String)/SwerveController.setChannel(java.lang.String)) on top of the raw Swerve drivetrain, so only whichever command currently "owns" the requested channel can actually move the robot.
SwerveControllerConstants
Configuration for a higher-level swerve auto-driving controller (e.g.
SwerveModuleConstants
Per-module hardware configuration for a single swerve module (motor CAN IDs, inversions and CANCoder calibration), consumed by SwerveModuleIOReal and SwerveModuleIOSim.
SwerveModuleIO
Hardware-agnostic interface for a single swerve module, following the AdvantageKit-style IO pattern: implementations drive the physical (or simulated) drive/steer motors and populate a plain SwerveModuleIO.SwerveModuleIOInputs data object each cycle.
SwerveModuleIO.SwerveModuleIOInputs
Plain data holder for one cycle's worth of module state, populated by SwerveModuleIO.update().
SwerveModuleIOReal
SwerveModuleIO implementation for a real swerve module driven by Controller-based drive/steer motors and a CTRE CANCoder absolute encoder.
SwerveModuleIOSim
SwerveModuleIO implementation for a simulated swerve module, backed by an ironmaple SwerveModuleSimulation and driven by its own drive/steer PIDControllers instead of real motor controllers.
SwerveSpeeds
A ChassisSpeeds that additionally remembers whether it is field-relative or robot-relative, so speeds can be passed around and converted between the two frames without the caller needing to track that separately.
SwerveSpeeds.SwerveSpeedsStruct
WPILib Struct implementation that lets SwerveSpeeds be logged/sent as a raw struct type.
SwerveUtils
Stateless math helpers for swerve module optimization and acceleration-limited velocity stepping.
TalonFXController
Controller implementation that wraps a CTRE TalonFX (Falcon 500/Kraken X60) motor controller via the Phoenix 6 API.
TalonSRXController
Controller implementation that wraps a CTRE TalonSRX motor controller via the legacy Phoenix 5 API.
VictorSPXController
Controller implementation that wraps a CTRE VictorSPX motor controller via the legacy Phoenix 5 API.
Vision
Top-level manager that aggregates every VisionCameraIO on the robot (any mix of LimelightVisionCameraIO, PhotonVisionCameraIO and, in simulation, PhotonVisionSimCameraIO) behind one API.
VisionCameraIO
IO layer for a single vision camera.
VisionConstants
Configuration for a Vision instance: which cameras to create, where they are mounted, how to obtain the AprilTag field layout, and how to read the robot's current pose.
VisionConstants.CameraType
The vision hardware/software backend a camera uses.
VisionFiltersCalculator
A pluggable sanity check for vision measurements, injected into RobotPose to decide which camera results are trustworthy enough to correct the pose estimate with.
VisionOutput
A single pose estimate and its supporting AprilTag detections, produced by one call to VisionCameraIO.update().
VisionOutput.VisionOutputStruct
WPILib Struct implementation that (de)serializes a VisionOutput to/from raw bytes.
VisionStrengthCalculator
A pluggable per-axis trust ("Kalman strength") calculator for vision measurements, injected into RobotPose and passed on to NinjasPoseTracker.setVisionMeasurementStrength(edu.wpi.first.math.Matrix<edu.wpi.first.math.numbers.N3, edu.wpi.first.math.numbers.N1>) for measurements that pass the configured VisionFiltersCalculator.
